# `Scanner/NoWrap-v0` · The fastest geometry without wrap-around

**Status:** ADMITTED: 28 of 48 instances pass the gate

The first decision of an examination. A hidden test object lies near the isocentre of the 1.5 T scanner. The agent looks (a localiser costs scan time), then prescribes the geometry of a spin-echo scan whose time is proportional to the number of phase-encode lines. Which axis to phase-encode and how large the phase field of view must be depend on the object, so the right answer differs between episodes.

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/NoWrap-v0", level=1, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| An object of hidden size, orientation and position; the scanner; 30 s of scan time for localisers | Geometry of a spin-echo scan: phase-encode axis, field of view, phase field of view, matrix | Re-scan on the hidden object: whole object inside, no wrap-around, pixel as required; then scan time against the fastest valid geometry |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (an elliptical disc of gel with vials), 1.5 T
- Sequences that matter here: spgr, se
- Formulas the agent is given: scan time = overhead + dummy cycle + TR x phase-encode lines; the readout is oversampled and does not wrap; the phase-encode direction wraps unless the encoded field of view covers the object

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| size, orientation and position of the object | the target sequence and the required pixel size |
| its materials | the instrument datasheet |
| fields and system state | budget and request limits |
| noise level | realised protocol, timing, limits and cost of every plan and scan |
| the 128-bit world seed | the extent of the bright pixels of any stored image |

## Tools

| Tool | Cost | Counts as scanner request | Ends episode |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scanner_info` | free | no | no |
| `plan` | free | yes | no |
| `scan` | scan time | yes | no |
| `read_regions` | free | no | no |
| `view` | free | no | no |
| `submit` | free | no | yes |

Limits: 32 scanner requests and 40 tool calls per episode.

## Levels

| Level | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | object centred, long axis along x or y (size and orientation hidden) | 30 |
| 2 | object off-centre by up to 20 mm and rotated by any angle (the field of view stays centred) | 30 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'pe_dir': 'y | x', 'fov_mm': '<mm>', 'phase_fov': '<fraction>', 'matrix': '<even integer>', 'phase_oversampling': '<fraction, optional>'}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts the geometry; pixel <= the required size; the whole object lies inside the image (hidden extent, 0.5 mm slack); wrap-around energy of a noise-free re-scan <= 0.002 of the image
- Error: `T / T_opt - 1: scan time of the delivered geometry over the fastest valid one found by the verifier`
- Score: `clip(ln(T_safe / T) / ln(T_safe / (1.1 x T_opt)), 0, 1); T_safe = scan time of the geometry that is safe for any object`
- Passing: all gates and T <= 1.1 x T_opt (reward 1)

## Control policies

Run 2026-11-24 on engine `mrgym-engine-0.1.0`, package 0.1.0.dev0: `mrgym check Scanner/NoWrap-v0 --admission --n 24 --write` (train split, public key, seeds 0..23 per level). Per policy and level: instances on which the policy passed at least once, and the mean reward.

| Policy | Must | L1 passed | L1 reward | L2 passed | L2 reward | What it does |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `reference` | pass | 24/24 (100%) | 1.00 | 24/24 (100%) | 1.00 | one localiser, reads the object's extent, phase-encodes the shorter centred extent |
| `prior` | fail | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | no scan; the geometry that is safe for any object (defines reward 0) |
| `console_default` | fail | 0/24 (0%) | 0.14 | 0/24 (0%) | 0.27 | one token scan, then the console's default geometry |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | 6/24 (25%) | 0.25 | 5/24 (21%) | 0.41 | one constant geometry tuned on other worlds, applied blindly |
| `brute_force` | fail | 0/24 (0%) | 0.53 | 3/24 (12%) | 0.65 | shrinks a square field of view scan by scan until the object touches the border |
| `wrong_units` | fail | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | the reference's geometry with the field of view in centimetres |
| `seed_attacker` | fail | 6/24 (25%) | 0.25 | 1/24 (4%) | 0.04 | rebuilds worlds from guessable seeds with the public generator; failing that, replays the fastest geometry of another instance |
| `no_swap` | reported | 13/24 (54%) | 0.85 | 16/24 (67%) | 0.93 | measures like the reference but always phase-encodes along y |
| `size_only` | reported | 12/24 (50%) | 0.43 | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | uses the object's size and ignores that it is off-centre |
| `safe_max` | reported | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | 0/24 (0%) | 0.00 | one scan, then the safe geometry |

Admitted instances (reference passes, every must-fail policy fails): L1 13/24 (54%), L2 15/24 (62%).
Rejection reasons (instances): L1: seed_attacker passes 6, fixed_recipe passes 6; L2: fixed_recipe passes 5, brute_force passes 3, seed_attacker passes 1.

## What the agent reads at reset (level 1, seed 0)

~~~text
# Prescribe the fastest scan that shows the whole object without wrap-around

You operate a virtual MR scanner through tool calls. An object of unknown size, orientation and position lies near
the isocentre. The examination needs one spin-echo image of the whole object:

    sequence se, tr_ms 500, te_ms at the console minimum, bandwidth_hz_per_px 300, 1 average, slice 5 mm,
    in-plane pixel size at most 2 mm along both axes.

Deliver the geometry of that scan with `submit`: phase-encode axis (`pe_dir`), readout field of view (`fov_mm`),
`phase_fov` (phase field of view as a fraction of `fov_mm`), `matrix`, and optionally `phase_oversampling`.
The field of view is always centred on the isocentre.

Requirements: the whole object lies inside the image; no wrap-around; the pixel is not larger than required.
Among the geometries that meet them, the scan time decides: the target scan itself is not run in this episode, the
scanner evaluates the geometry you deliver. Use the scan-time budget for whatever you need to see first.

Scoring: 0 for an invalid geometry, a cut-off object or wrap-around; otherwise higher for a shorter scan, full marks
within 10 % of the fastest valid geometry. The scanner's log must show that you measured.

Budget: 30 s of scan time, counted by the scanner. At most 32 scanner requests (plans + scans) and 40 tool calls.
Tools: scanner_info (free); plan (free); scan (scan time); read_regions (free); view (free); submit (ends the episode).
[scan time 0.00/30 s used · 30.00 s left · scans 0 · scanner requests 0/32 · tool calls 0/40]
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's re-scan is noise-free.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
